assumptions.assumption: A device reply/acknowledgment is distinct from completing the native instruction in KVM.
assumptions.basis: Retained KVM API section5 and independent native completion probes.
assumptions.dependent_result: Owned transfer persists until subsequent native KVM_RUN completes or returns the documented completion EINTR.
assumptions.stress_test: PIO/MMIO scalar and REP, incomplete reply, unacknowledged output, read-modify-write followon output and kernel EINTR.
assumptions.falsification_probe: A device-only completion makes a public overlay admissible, drops a payload, repeats an acknowledged device effect or lets the following instruction run early.
assumptions.status: Production ten-case target passed; historical independent EINTR/type-seam results retained separately.

assumptions.assumption: Each REP element repeats the scalar port transaction at the original port.
assumptions.basis: VcpuExit element-width/count contract and port-I/O instruction semantics; selected UART model register map.
assumptions.dependent_result: Generic/serial byte lanes advance within one element; each next element restarts at the same port; IDE data FIFO bytes retain the fixed port.
assumptions.stress_test: Widths1/2/4, count256, DF0/1, nonuniform data, generic lanes, serial scratch register and IDE FIFO.
assumptions.falsification_probe: The actual Vmm guest fails to see UART.SCR=0x5a in the fourth byte of any input dword.
assumptions.status: Observed actual Vmm baseline0xbad0bad0 and corrected0x5a5a5a5a; all256 dwords verified.

assumptions.assumption: A public register overlay preserves kernel MP startup/halt state; register setters can otherwise mark a CPU runnable.
assumptions.basis: Primary GET/SET_MP_STATE UAPI and retained Linux x86 KVM implementation.
assumptions.dependent_result: Capture MP before reading/applying public banks and restore it last, including rollback.
assumptions.stress_test: Actual managed CPU CR8 overlay; independently GET/SET kernel MP states0/1/2/3 through the sole stopped process-owned CPU FD; verify unchanged GPRs and intended CR8.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Overlay changes a seeded native MP state, alters unrelated GPRs, or fails to apply CR8.
assumptions.status: Baseline UNINITIALIZED1 became RUNNABLE0; corrected complete production library preserved all four tested values. SMM/blocked INIT/SIPI and coordinated controller restore remain unqualified.

assumptions.assumption: A public register observation must not consume queued INIT while native IO owns the current instruction.
assumptions.basis: GET_MP_STATE accepts APIC events, while public register projection requires no MP backup.
assumptions.dependent_result: Read banks directly for observation; only an admitted overlay captures MP before banks and restores it last.
assumptions.stress_test: Actual AP1 input, BSP0 ICR INIT, independent GET_REGS before/after managed get_state, exact input reply and subsequent native INIT wait.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Public observation changes RIP/GPRs or loses the pending native completion.
assumptions.status: Exact paired production probe: baseline RIP1000->fff0, corrected1000->1000 followed by completed input and INIT wait; all10 owning native cases and4 MP values passed.

bounded_findings.finding: Owned IO metadata and rejecting public overlays do not implement a complete native checkpoint. Kernel completion/coordinated capture remain required.
Direct embedding clients must acknowledge dispatched output and inspect input completion errors; the Vmm loop already follows this trait contract.

public_observation.baseline_result: Actual managed public get_state changed pending-input AP RIP0x1000->0xfff0 by accepting queued INIT.
public_observation.corrected_result: RIP remains0x1000; input then completes before INIT wait. All4 MP values and the whole native10-case IO target pass again.
